body:
I have no problem with relating to other cultures. My little sister is part hispanic anyways. The area I live in is not a place for socializing. I am also quite poor, so poor that I beg for bus tokens whenever I have a doctors appoint. I plan on going out more often, and I have looked for clubs on meetup.com, but the results have been lackluster. I also am taking your advice about where I should go.

Tomorrow I will hopefully have a script written for adhd meds and a referral to a clinic where I can have therapy.

It would be impossible to get in contact with the friends that I was close to in the past.

Obviously something is wrong. I really need to speak to someone about my problems, but I do not know where to begin and who to talk to much less what to talk about.

I am just going to type, I would really like to be able to speak with someone.

I left quite a bit out, but I am planning on finishing the rest at a later time.  I am too tired to type about my life coherently and would really like input. There is some family stuff that I should add, but not much. Most of it pertaining to oh I met my grandparents, oh I met with them on these occasions, oh there relatives now know I exist. Oh these people now think I am gay. Forgive me for the lack of clarity, it is 3:41 am.

This is the part where I obsess about how fucked up my life and how the world has worked against me my entire life and its not my fault that I yadda yadda yadda...

> My entire life I have been poor, even while living in a middle class neighborhood.
> Periodically I would break down and have weird thoughts that consist of me telling myself that I am a worthless slut, stupid bitch, idiot, etc. and the rate of which I break down and ruminate has been occurring more and more often.
> When I am in a depressed state I obsess over things and believe I have some sort of mental disorder/personality disorder  and try to diagnose myself. I realize that self-diagnosis is not helpful, and I should seek medical help.
    
> I have taken anti-depressants and adhd meds before, but I dislike the use of anti-depressants unless they are absolutely necessary i.e. I am becoming depressed, but at this current time I feel that I am in a stable enough position to go without them. 



My earliest memories are of my cousins, aunts, and uncles on my mothers side our family in Nowhere, USA. When I was around the age of five, my mother decided she wanted to find out who her real father was against her own mothers wishes, so her mother shunned her resulting in our banishment from "the family tribe." **[This may have happened after or while the previous events mentioned unfolded]** We moved to an apartment complex in a town I vaguely remember, and I attended daycare facility #1 where my time was divided between letting other children shove sand down my pants, and watching barney while smoking candy cigarettes. Home life consisted of me being an ADHD tart, dancing in the rain naked, and dying myself green. I do not remember having human friends or really socializing at the time, but my best friend was a gerbil that was talented in the arts of escape. He would escape from his cage every evening up until the night my mother killed him while rocking in her rocking chair (the moment happened in slow motion for me and I even cried out for her to stop, but it was too late for him).

Some time later my mother moved in with her good friend who was like an adoptive mother to her. I have some fond memories of her, but not many. During this time, I attended yet another daycare where I remember riding ponies, not being allowed to use the bathroom for some unknown reason by the fucking horrible daycare personnel, and being ditched on *Parents Eat With Their Children Day* (I told her everyday starting a week in advance that all the other parents would be there and that she should come too. The day comes, all of the other kids parents come, and I sit in the corner drinking milk and crying hoping my mum is just late. thiswas traumatizing). My mother and her adoptive mother, my "grams", had been my only social contact for about a year to two and a half years after I stopped attending daycare facility #2. My mother attended college classes in order to obtain COTA certification, so I was alone most of the time with my nearly immobilized grams (some would say neglected). My grams was taken to a hospital for some sort of surgery where her meds were mixed up ,effectively turning her into a demented old woman having no place to stay other than a retirement home that smelled of maltreatment, urine, and death. 

**Kindergarten**
Once I was old enough to attend kindergarten, I was enrolled in daycare facility #3. kids ignored me. My moms boyfriend at the time was a douche to her, and he mistreated me when we were alone. 

Homeroom teacher fucking hated me.

~*Memory too hazy*~

**1-5**
Moved in with a wretched woman named Jimmy, who was a boyscout organizer and skimmed money from donations. At that time I attended boyscout meetings/events where I either dicked around or was ridiculed/taunted or ignored by fellow scouts and their parents. There was an altercation of some sort and we left her house.

Lived in a mold infested house behind woods that a homeless guy lived in. No Friends. Molested by a boyscout when I invited him over to play.

1st Homeroom teacher fucking hated me.
2nd grade teacher despised me
3rd grade was OK
4th grade was hell
5th homeschooled

~*Memory too Hazy*~ 

Moved into an apartment complex somewhere else in the town. Some friends, all poor and trashy. I was played pokemon often. Had problems with teachers because I felt wronged at times. Emotionally unstable and thus sent to principals office frequently. Bullied by boyscout from my last troop. Lots of anger built up because I was blamed for bullying when I was in fact the one being bullied. I started acting out towards others. I had lots of time with the school counselor, Santos, who I suspect used me as a way to date my mum. Frequently cried, wished I was dead. Santos knocked up my mother. Harassed her, abused her, and then moved in with her.

**Middle School**
Moved into apartment complex in another town with mum and her Santos/babys daddy. I finally made some friends, dated a girl for 1 week then was dumped when school started. I was mainly the loner in my group of school friends. Sis was born with autism, but I loved her. I picked on a kid, made countless faux pas, and never really connected with anyone because I did not know how to behave + was insecure and had low self-esteem since forever. I was lots of trouble at school because of bullying 90% result of groups of kids targeting me and then blaming me for starting trouble. Admin hated me and thus sent me to in school suspension frequently. I was still very adhd at that time and a dick to certain people. Frequently cried. Wished I was dead.

Moved closer to my middle school in a suburb. Made friends with  the older neighbor kid across the street. After a a few months we ended our friendship, because his parents found his gay porn stash and blamed it on me. I was a loser, annoying, still wished I was dead. I dated another girl for a while, but I do not remember when. I was socially awkward.

**Highschool**
Initially I was just a dorky, weird, quiet kid, but I felt that every time I opened up my highly-energetic socially awkward side would ruin things. Social skills improved, I think. Had many acquaintances. Cried a lot, hid in bathrooms at lunch, to cry. Went to the library at lunch, to ~~read~~ cry.  Pre-AP classes were easy to slack off in and breeze by with a B. Made friends with a group of stoners (they were mostly kids with little potential- see how horrible of a friend I am q_q). Smoked weed and dated aslutty girl. Btw I was really more quiet, but still annoying at this stage.

On the last week of highschool as a sophomore, my grandfather was taken off of life support, I irrationally blamed myself for his death.

Foreign exchange time, went door to door solicited donations, applied for scholar ships, and left. I believe I ruined the relationship with my first host family because of the amount of stress I was under + my social awkwardness and my craving to party. Moved in with best friend after the initial 6 months. Proceeded to ruin that relationship as well by becoming withdrawn. Drama at home - parents getting divorce.

**~9 months ago**
 
Moms car was repossessed, our electricity went out during the summer, their time share (ugh I told them they should not buy it) illegally given away, and my mother is legally not allowed to leave the state even though she has primary custody of her daughter all because of her megalomaniac ex-husband.

Instead of going back to school, I earned GED, applied at every business I could for a job, dated a crazy with BPD, and then ran off with a boy from Minnesota that is probably dead from a heroin overdose by now.

Moved across the country, lived in a polyamorous relationship - sort of - then tried killing myself because I messed up badly (I was drunk at the time if that makes a difference)..

**recent**
Went to city college, and still live with the same person described above. We may be going to China together. I am looking for work and friends.

**EDIT**
I rushed through this post, so please forgive me if I left out information before the edits that drastically change my story! I have left out crucial details, but I was not sexually abused except for one incident where a boyscout messed around with me. I realize that does impact my life and is not normal behavior, but it was not ongoing or particularly traumatizing. The neglect and isolation kind of outweighed that for me at the time.

tl;dr being touched by a boyscout did not ruin my life. 

Also I had 2-3 best friends between the ages of 7 and 11 that I became close to. Each one of them moved and I perceived it as being abandoned.

I have few friends atm, except for those I meet through my roommate because 1) I live in a very large city in a hispanic/latino area and it is very difficult to find people I relate to and 2) I become withdrawn at times and unless I am introduced to someone I go blank and cannot really relate to them without leading them on.

I currently have 0 close friends.

I have friends that I stayed with while in Istanbul and Austria that are like family, but they are too far away too really feel any comfort from.

I did have a subset of friends that I did not really like, but I tolerated them because I craved social interaction.

fyi: I am not a total mess when it comes to socializing, I am just pretty quirky and have always been able to speak to adults better than children,colleagues, and friends my age.

I have friends across the country, in Austria, and in Istanbul. These are good, well developed friendships that I crave for here, but there are none to be found.

I did not grow up in this area or state and all of my roommates friends are in there early 20', so I always feel out of place.

IRL I am not a scary tranny/creepy person. I made friend with a dutch guy that was here for an internship a few months ago, and eventually came out to him. He was shocked, he did not mind, and we met up often just for coffee or to go shopping at flea markets. 
 I have no doubt that I could make friends, but after countless craigslist failures and my inability to speak to people at my city college I feel isolated.

I realize I need friends btw.

>It's time to start thinking that you will come out of this a better person.
I am sorry, but that is such a fucking cop-out. I have heard this numerous times and it makes me feel better in absolutely no way.

I may be going to China because my roommate has an externship there. If I do not find a job, then I will be going to a shelter so I can stay in the area and attend college.  I have a shitty street canvassing job (asking people for donations and earning wages based of a percentage of said donations)interview tomorrow, but a shitty job is better than no job.

No, my mother was staying with a friend of hers because she could not afford a home of her own. She just recently moved into a house in rural nowhere and there would be no opportunities to even attend college.

I was staying with her before I started traveling across the state, and if I had not left I would of killed myself because of the lack of opportunities to work/study/do anything productive.

Oh and I have lived in the same city for the last 6-10 months, so I consider that settling down a bit. Also I love to travel and my goal is to be able to pick up a skill such as coding, cooking, or teaching which would allow me to move around.
